sourceMapping: Actual original 48x48 icon, complete original board and exact cropped source were visually inspected. Catalog order independently agreed. Legacy in-memory reconstruction matched all original runtime pixels.
preservedMotifs: One gloved index finger presses a cyan permission interface at the center of one circular bronze/graphite access mechanism with amber ring segments. The whole mechanical circle and completed short wrist cuff are visible. The dark source wall/card is excluded.
rendering: Chunky broad matte sci-fi cel shading, dark outline, opaque local action glyphs, transparent exterior.
native48Limitations: Finger joints, small panel seams and bevels simplify at 48 pixels, but the hand pressing the interface remains visible. The complete wrist cuff has a narrow 15-pixel right margin, below the requested 8–10 percent; no finger, cuff or circle edge is clipped. No train, added permission symbol or faction emblem was invented.
semanticReconstruction: Source-faithful redraw. Rail permission uses the separately recovered full source card to restore the clipped right strip and complete wrist; card/wall background is excluded. Other motifs use exact legacy source slots. No topic reassignment or invented gameplay effect.
legacySourceCropDefect: Uniform grid crop ends at x=309 while the complete intended card extends to x=315, clipping a narrow right-hand strip. The original runtime also carries the dark scene-card background.
